header: A new Bedrock Cosmos mini-update is here!
body:
Welcome to Bedrock Cosmos v1.1.2! We've collaborated with even more creators to bring you some new content as we are continuing to work on our next major update!

An assortment of capes have been added by Wizardry, which are themed around different types of scenery! We also have added a handful of new skin packs, as well as updating a few from previous updates to add new skins!

What's next for Bedrock Cosmos? If you haven't been keeping up with the teasers in our Discord server, our next major update for our Windows launcher will include a menu editor! This will allow you to customize which capes and skin packs appear in your in-game menus to allow for better customization.

Feel free to check out our changelog as well for the full update details. Thanks for being a part of Bedrock Cosmos!
